tune:
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: Aggressively explore the static_v gate vector of gated_fno. The goal of this run is to characterize the gating spectrum, NOT to find the best overall hyperparameters.

MANDATORY CONSTRAINTS (do not violate):
1. Set gate_step = 0.1 in every round. Do not vary gate_step in this run.
2. Every round MUST use a static_v shape that is meaningfully DIFFERENT from every previous round in this run. Track what you have already tried. Repeating the same shape (or trivial perturbations of it) is forbidden.
3. static_v entries must lie on the discrete grid {0.0, 0.1, 0.2, ..., 1.0}. The pydantic validator will reject anything else.
4. DO NOT only try binary {0, 1} masks. The whole point of gate_step=0.1 is to enable SMOOTH curves. At least 70% of the rounds in this run must use static_v vectors that contain at least three distinct values from the grid (i.e., not just 0.0 and 1.0).
5. Other model_config fields (width, num_layers, num_gates, gate_mapping) and train_config fields (lr, epochs, batch_size, optimizer) should stay close to their defaults across rounds. Do NOT waste rounds tuning them. Their role is to be a stable substrate so that variation in denoising score can be attributed to static_v, not to confounders.

SHAPES TO EXPLORE (cover several of these — do not repeat the same family):
- Smooth low-pass with varying cutoff: e.g. low-pass at gate index 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64. Use a soft transition like [1.0, 1.0, 0.9, 0.7, 0.4, 0.1, 0.0, ...] rather than a hard step.
- Smooth high-pass with varying cutoff (mirror of above).
- Soft band-pass at different center frequencies and bandwidths: e.g. [0.0, 0.2, 0.6, 1.0, 1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.0, ...] and shifted variants.
- Linear ramp down: [1.0, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.0, ...].
- Linear ramp up (mirror).
- Graded protection on weak bands: [0.2, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, ...] — partial attenuation, not full zeroing.
- Notch (band-stop): mostly 1.0 with a small dip to 0.0 at one or two indices.
- Comb / multi-band: alternating high/low values.

CONTEXT FOR WHY THIS RUN EXISTS: A previous gated_fno tuning run produced 21 rounds but only tried 2 distinct static_v shapes — one shape was repeated 16 times across rounds while other (irrelevant) hyperparameters were thrashed. The best score came from a binary low-pass mask the agent stumbled into early and then never deviated from. That is exactly the failure mode this run must avoid. Vary the curve SHAPE, not just the cutoff position, and not just the surrounding hyperparameters.
